text: Two robbers dug a tunnel into a bank for a whole year. They came up in the wrong building. The plan was perfect. Two shovels. One map. Upside down. Three hundred and sixty five days of digging. Not one day off. They burst through the floor into the police station. During the Christmas party. Nobody arrested them. The chief was impressed. Now they dig the new police car park. For free. Forever. Would you have checked the map? Be honest.
